entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into a return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To get started, can I have your order number?
It's VF8675309. And don't give me the runaround. I want to send this thing back.
Thank you. I'm pulling that up now. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a matter of it being useless! I don't care what you call it. And I swear, if you tell me it's **too late** or give me some ridiculous excuse about **hygiene** or **sanitation** rules, I am going to lose it. I know your website **policy**.
I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to verify the purchase date and the specific item against our current return policy. Please give me just one moment to review your file.
You'd better be quick. This is unacceptable. If you can't handle this, put me through to your manager right now. I'm one click away from blasting VeloFit on every review site on the internet.
Thank you for your patience. I've got your order details here. I see you purchased the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and it was delivered 42 days ago.
So? Are you going to take it back or not?
Yes, absolutely. You're well within our 90-day return window for this item. I can process this return for a full refund immediately. My apologies for any confusion.
Oh. Really? Just like that? You'll take it back?

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email as we speak with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Wow. Okay. Well... thank you, Diana. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
